test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Some parts of a few sentences have been jumbled up, and labelled A, B, C and D. Select the option that gives the correct sequence in which these parts can be rearranged to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

I didn't speak to the sage again for many years,

A. seer, born on a dark island of a union between an ascetic and a fisher princess

B. because of the many hefty books, he'd written. Vyasa the

C. though I heard of him from time to time. I learned

D. his name: Vyasa the Compendious,
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** correct sequence** to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence is **CDBA.**
 
• Let's break it down:
 
 
• **C.** "though I heard of him from time to time. I learned" - **This segment forms the continuation** of the first part of the sentence ("I didn't speak to the sage again for many years") as it explains what happened during the years of not speaking to the sage. It also creates a logical link to the next segment (D) by mentioning that the speaker learned something.
 
• **D. **"his name: Vyasa the Compendious," - **This segment provides the information** the speaker learned, i.e., the sage's name. It also logically leads to the next segment (B) which adds more information about Vyasa.
 
• **B. **"because of the many hefty books, he'd written. Vyasa the" - **This segment adds additional information **about Vyasa, and then ends with a partial phrase ("Vyasa the") that logically leads to the final segment (A), which completes this description.
 
• **A.** "seer, born on a dark island of a union between an ascetic and a fisher princess" - **This segment finalizes the description** of Vyasa, completing the sentence in a coherent and meaningful way.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *"I didn't speak to the sage again for many years, though I heard of him from time to time. I learned his name: Vyasa the Compendious, because of the many hefty books, he'd written. Vyasa the seer, born on a dark island of a union between an ascetic and a fisher princess." So, the correct answer is CDBA.*
